Name: Bigger Machines
Author: jokthefoo
Description:
[size=6][b]Bigger Machines[/b][/size]
Is a framework mod to allow content packs to easily add big craftables larger than one tile!

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]

[size=3][b]For players[/b][/size]
This mod does nothing on its own; you need to install content packs by unzipping them into your
`Mods` folder.  
See _Requirements_ > _Mods requiring this file_ on the Nexus mod page to find
content packs.

[size=3][b]For mod authors[/b][/size]
[url=https://github.com/jokthefoo/StardewMods/tree/main/BiggerMachines]Documentation and Source Code[/url]

[b]Compatibility[/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

[b]Credits[/b]
Artwork for the cubes and some draw code:
[url=https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/blob/develop/BiggerCraftables]Spacechase0's Bigger Craftables[/url]
